update.releaseNotes:
### What's New in 3.0.4.0
**CIGI Input Upgrade** - 3Waves now understands the CIGI data format directly. Pick CIGI from Input Formatting -> Axis Order and the app reads the right aircraft orientation from the simulator's CIGI stream, even when the simulator includes other entities like ships or targeting pods. - A new "Ownship Entity ID" field lets you tell 3Waves which entity is the aircraft (defaults to 0, which is the standard). - The CIGI input profile now listens on port 6000 by default, matching the standard IG relay setup.
**Under the Hood** - Existing input profiles (MSFS, Prepar3D, etc.) are preserved exactly as before. No changes needed on your end.
